lines.en: Young tiger growls as it walks

lines.zh: 我小跳着跟上大猫的脚印。
lines.en: I hop along the big cat's prints.

lines.zh: 我的短腿踩得落叶沙沙响。
lines.en: My short legs crackle through fallen leaves.
I run two steps and look back for you.

lines.zh: 我颈毛没长齐，走路直晃。
lines.en: My mane's still thin, so I wobble when I walk.

lines.zh: 阳光一晒，我的乳牙发亮。
lines.en: In the sun, my milk teeth shine.
Sunlight rests on my little fangs.
My milk fangs have only just come in.

lines.zh: 我这副小獠牙，还得再长。
lines.en: These little sabers still have growing to do.
I lick a paw, then freeze.

lines.zh: 我伏在巢边，耳朵转来转去。
lines.en: I lie by the den, ears swiveling.
Staring at the player with intent
I shrink into my mother's shadow.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴尖一下一下地拍地。
lines.en: My tail tip taps the ground.

lines.zh: 你的脚踝，正好一口大小。
lines.en: Your ankle is just the right size for a bite.

lines.zh: 我的牙还没长齐，先看着。
lines.en: My fangs aren't grown in. I just watch.

lines.zh: 你每动一下，我耳朵就转一次。
lines.en: Every move you make turns an ear.
My little sabers aren't fully grown.
So much meat, can eat for long.

lines.zh: 我长大也要像爸爸一样！
lines.en: I’ll be like Dad when grown.
Watch out! I’m going to hit you.

lines.zh: 我撞在你的膝盖上，弹开。
lines.en: I hit your knee and bounce off.

lines.zh: 乳牙刚长齐，也想试一试。
lines.en: My milk fangs just came in. Let me try.
You’re too small, I’m going to hit you.

lines.zh: 我们互相理毛，先这样吧。
lines.en: Let's groom each other; that's enough for now.
I want to be a dad!

lines.zh: 等我长出獠牙，再说这个。
lines.en: Ask me again when my fangs grow in.
I’m going to produce fur and cubs!

lines.zh: 幼剑锋闪烁于丛林阴影中
lines.en: Sharp claws glint in the forest shadows.
I drag my catch back to the den.
Juvenile saber hides in the grass.

lines.zh: 爪子在树皮上留下痕迹

lines.en: Wait for prey in the bushes.

lines.zh: 我学母兽的样子压低身子。
lines.en: I crouch low the way my mother does.

lines.zh: 察觉到猎物的细微动静
我把鼻子贴到你的靴上。
lines.en: I press my nose to your boot.

lines.zh: 我第一次盯住会跑的猎物。
lines.en: For the first time I lock onto fleeing prey.
I crouch the way my mother does.

lines.zh: 我吼了一声，自己先愣住。
lines.en: I let out a roar and startle myself.
Your ankle has caught my eye.

lines.zh: 我绕到你侧后，脚步很轻。
lines.en: I slip to your flank, very light on my feet.
Tail swaying, I work out the distance.

lines.zh: 我的乳牙露出来，还不够尖。
lines.en: My milk teeth show, not sharp enough yet.

lines.zh: 蓄力时我的屁股左右扭。
lines.en: My hindquarters wiggle as I wind up.

lines.zh: 我等你露出不会躲的时机。
lines.en: I wait for a moment you won't dodge.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上抓出浅痕。
lines.en: My claws leave shallow marks in the ground.
I try to quiet my breathing.
Before a pounce I always twitch.

lines.zh: 我的注意力全在你的脚上。
lines.en: All my attention is on your feet.

lines.zh: 我的爪子先搭上你的小腿。
lines.en: My claws find your calf first.
I miss, but roll upright at once.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的裤脚，死不松口。
lines.en: I lock my teeth in your trouser leg.
I pounce and cling to your leg.
I swipe once and dart away.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的衣角不松口。
lines.en: I bite your sleeve and won't let go.

lines.zh: 我的剑齿磕在甲上，疼了自己。
lines.en: My sabers clang on your armor and hurt me.
I leap high and miss entirely.

lines.zh: 我滚了一圈又爬起来冲。
lines.en: I roll over and charge again.
I headbutt you with surprising force.

lines.zh: 我的爪子钩住你的披风。
lines.en: My claws hook into your cloak.
I hiss and back behind the grass.
Under the moon, my milk teeth show first.

lines.zh: 我从母兽的毛里探出头。
lines.en: I poke my head out of my mother's fur.

lines.zh: 草丛深处传来我细弱的叫。
lines.en: My thin cry rises from deep in the grass.

lines.zh: 我追着蝴蝶跌跌撞撞出来。
lines.en: I tumble out chasing a butterfly.
The incubator opens, and I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 幼崽的腿，还撑不住这一摔。
lines.en: A cub's legs can't take a fall like that.
I'm thrashing in the water, pull me out!
My little sabers aren't fully grown.
The arrow is stuck in my shoulder blade.

lines.zh: 母兽没回来，我肚子空了。
lines.en: Mother hasn't returned; my belly is empty.

lines.zh: 雷声太响，我炸毛缩成一团。
lines.en: The thunder is too loud; I puff up and curl tight.
